s00-01-story-eaadbf.wav.text: The richest man in town, hiding up a tree.

s00-02-pivot-f64cab.wav.text: He thought he was looking for Jesus.

s01-02-story-b4cc99.wav.text: He collected taxes for Rome, and took extra for himself.

s01-03-grave-bf6138.wav.text: A man called by the name Zacchaeus.

s01-04-grave-04735e.wav.text: He was a chief tax collector and was rich.

s01-05-talk-bfbc7d.wav.text: To everyone in Jericho, he was a traitor and a thief.

s02-01-story-3ecc3e.wav.text: One day Jesus came through Jericho, and Zacchaeus wanted to see him.

s02-02-grave-3ab9d3.wav.text: He was seeking to see who Jesus was, but on account of the crowd he could not,

s02-03-grave-c2e59c.wav.text: because he was small in stature.

s02-04-story-6d8e98.wav.text: So he ran ahead, and climbed a sycamore tree.

s03-01-pivot-955719.wav.text: When Jesus reached the spot, he stopped, and looked up, and called him by name.

s03-02-grave-09f5eb.wav.text: Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for I must stay at your house today.

s03-03-story-369814.wav.text: Zacchaeus hurried down, full of joy.

s04-02-story-cae50f.wav.text: He's gone to be the guest of a sinner.

s04-04-grave-1a392e.wav.text: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor.

s04-05-grave-a05eba.wav.text: And if I have defrauded anyone of anything, I restore it fourfold.

s05-01-talk-2999f3.wav.text: Zacchaeus thought he was looking for Jesus.

s05-03-grave-c10e65.wav.text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
